name: universal-agent-sdk
description: Standalone Universal Agent Client SDK and ACP adapters

scripts.build:workflow: pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-contract build && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-runtime build && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-node build && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-agents build && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-ui build && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-web build && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-server build
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:adapters && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/client build && pnpm run build:workflow
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test:workflow-dist: pnpm run build:workflow && pnpm --filter @universal-agent/workflow-agents run test:dist
